# pingu

A friendly, colorful replacement for the `ping` command with an ASCII penguin.

Features

- Colorful and fun output.
- Cross-platform support: Windows, macOS, and Linux (also WSL).
- Single executable for easy installation.
- Supports both IPv4 and IPv6.

Usage

Simply specify the target host name or IP address in the first argument, e.g. `pingu github.com` or `pingu 13.114.40.48`.
You can change the number of transmissions by specifying the `-c` option.

```
Usage:
  pingu [OPTIONS] HOST

`ping` command but with pingu

Application Options:
  -c, --count=     Stop after <count> replies (default: 20)
  -P, --privilege  Enable privileged mode
  -V, --version    Show version

Help Options:
  -h, --help       Show this help message
```

Installation

Download executable binaries from the releases page of this project and place the binary in your PATH.

WSL support

To run on WSL, grant the binary the necessary capability and run with the `-P` or `--privilege` option.

```
# Example: allow raw sockets on Linux (may require sudo)
sudo setcap cap_net_raw=+ep /path/to/pingu

# Then run with privilege mode
pingu -P github.com
```

	penguinWhite  = newStyle(fgHiWhite, attrBold)
	penguinRed    = newStyle(fgHiRed, attrBold)
	penguinYellow = newStyle(fgHiYellow, attrBold)
)

// penguinRow renders the n-th row of the penguin (wrapping around).
func penguinRow(n int) string {
	rows := len(penguinRows)
	idx := n % rows
	if idx < 0 {
		idx += rows
	}
	var sb strings.Builder
	for _, c := range penguinRows[idx] {
		switch c {
		case 'k':
			sb.WriteString(penguinBlack.wrap("#"))
		case 'w':
			sb.WriteString(penguinWhite.wrap("#"))
		case 'r':
			sb.WriteString(penguinRed.wrap("#"))
		case 'y':
			sb.WriteString(penguinYellow.wrap("#"))
		default:
			sb.WriteRune(c)
		}
	}
	return sb.String()
}

	exitErrPing     = 2

	styleBytes   = newStyle(fgHiBlue, attrBold)

	styleRecv    = newStyle(fgHiGreen, attrBold)
	styleLoss    = newStyle(fgHiRed, attrBold)
	styleMin     = newStyle(fgHiBlue, attrBold)
	styleAvg     = newStyle(fgHiCyan, attrBold)
	styleMax     = newStyle(fgHiGreen, attrBold)
	styleStdDev  = newStyle(fgMagenta, attrBold)
	styleErrTag  = newStyle(fgRed, attrBold)
)

func printError(format string, a ...interface{}) {
	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[ %s ] %s\n", styleErrTag.wrap("ERROR"), fmt.Sprintf(format, a...))
}

func main() {
	os.Exit(run(os.Args[1:]))
}

func run(argv []string) int {
	opts, args, err := parseArgs(argv)
	if err != nil {
		if pe, ok := err.(*parseError); ok && pe.help {
			fmt.Fprintln(os.Stdout, pe.msg)
			return exitOK
		}
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
		printError("parse error: %s", err)
		return exitErrArgs
	}

	if opts.Version {
		fmt.Printf("%s: %s\n", appName, appVersion)
		return exitOK
	}

	if len(args) == 0 {
		printError("must requires an argument")
		return exitErrArgs
	}
	if len(args) > 1 {
		printError("too many arguments")
		return exitErrArgs
	}

	pinger, err := NewPinger(args[0])
	if err != nil {
		printError("an error occurred while initializing pinger: %s", fmt.Sprintf("failed to init pinger %s", err))
		return exitOK
	}

	pinger.Count = opts.Count
	pinger.SetPrivileged(opts.Privilege)

	pinger.OnRecv = func(pkt *Packet) {
		fmt.Printf("%s seq=%s %sbytes from %s: ttl=%s time=%s\n",
			penguinRow(pkt.Seq),
			styleSeq.wrap(fmt.Sprint(pkt.Seq)),
			styleBytes.wrap(fmt.Sprint(pkt.Nbytes)),
			styleAddr.wrap(pkt.IPAddr.String()),
			styleTTL.wrap(fmt.Sprint(pkt.TTL)),
			styleTime.wrap(pkt.Rtt.String()),
		)
	}

	pinger.OnFinish = func(stats *Statistics) {
		rule := strings.Repeat("─", 9)
		fmt.Print(styleHeader.line(fmt.Sprintf("\n%s %s ping statistics %s", rule, stats.Addr, rule)))
		fmt.Printf("%s: %s transmitted => %s received (%s loss)\n",
			styleTitle.wrap("PACKET STATISTICS"),
			styleSent.wrap(fmt.Sprint(stats.PacketsSent)),
			styleRecv.wrap(fmt.Sprint(stats.PacketsRecv)),
			styleLoss.wrap(fmt.Sprintf("%v%%", stats.PacketLoss)),
		)
		fmt.Printf("%s: min=%s avg=%s max=%s stddev=%s\n",
			styleTitle.wrap("ROUND TRIP"),
			styleMin.wrap(stats.MinRtt.String()),
			styleAvg.wrap(stats.AvgRtt.String()),
			styleMax.wrap(stats.MaxRtt.String()),
			styleStdDev.wrap(stats.StdDevRtt.String()),
		)
	}

	sigCh := make(chan os.Signal, 1)
	signal.Notify(sigCh, os.Interrupt)
	go func() {
		for range sigCh {
			pinger.Stop()
		}
	}()

	fmt.Print(styleTitle.line(fmt.Sprintf("PING %s (%s) type `Ctrl-C` to abort", pinger.Addr(), pinger.IPAddr())))

	if err := pinger.Run(); err != nil {
		printError("an error occurred when running ping: %s", err)
		return exitErrPing
	}

	return exitOK
}
